a corpse is not confused with ground

so that it does not swell
the baraita: and one seals up its orifices

and Solomon too said in his wisdom: 'before the silver cord is snapped, and the golden bowl is shattered, and the pitcher is broken at the fountain, and the wheel runs into the pit' (Eccl 12:6)
'before the silver cord is snapped' -- this is the spinal cord
'and the golden bowl is shattered' -- this is the member
'and the pitcher is broken at the fountain' -- this is the stomach
'and the wheel runs into the pit' -- this is excrement
and so it says: 'and I will spread dung upon your faces, the dung of your festivals' (Mal 2:3)
these are people who abandon words of Torah and make all their days like festivals
after three days [the dead man's] stomach bursts and falls upon his face, and says to him: take what you put in me
